prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1128; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain and stiffness. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the injury described, and the symptom pattern is typical for a cervical strain of this kind. Over the course of sixteen visits, care consisted of physical examination, range-of-motion assessment, a structured therapy program, and home exercise instruction. Physical examination identified reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, supporting the diagnosis, while certain neurological screening tests returned normal results. No prior injury to the cervical region is documented in the available history. The course of treatment followed a conventional progression, with visit frequency decreasing as the patient's symptoms improved and pain levels declined. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, with no duplicated charges identified. At last review, the patient was improving and was discharged to self-directed home exercise.
